objective: Implement and verify QIF v0.6.36 Escalation Resolution and Timeliness

assignment.assignment_reason: Builder extends governed selective escalation into auditable resolution under Visionary scope and Guardian evidence boundaries.

capability_fit.rationale: Existing route policies and decisions provide deterministic inputs for resolution policy, elapsed-time, availability, and governance checks.

acceptance_criteria: Every resolution resolves to one selective escalation decision, policy, and actual route.
Elapsed time, timeliness, disposition, availability, evidence status, and assessment summaries are reproducible.
Timeout, lateness, unavailability, invalid redirect, unverified evidence, and insufficient data route to governance.

review_criteria.criterion: resolution arithmetic and evidence boundaries are deterministic
review_criteria.evidence_required: positive package validation and retained negative fixtures

blocker_semantics.trigger_condition: response time, resolution volume, or disposition is treated as quality, competence, authority, or causal proof
blocker_semantics.recovery_action: restore operational-evidence-only semantics and explicit governance

hri_projection.speech_bubble: I will show how each escalation actually resolved.
hri_projection.next_action: Submit resolution evidence and verifier results
